source_path_base: Paths in source fields are relative to the voice-agent repository root. ../docs is external evaluation evidence and is not bundled with this template.
definition_fingerprint_algorithm: SHA256 of json.dumps(definition, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=True).encode('utf-8'). This is a semantic JSON fingerprint, not the raw file SHA256.

provenance.source_form: Portable authored {name, description, definition} document; exact source bytes, not a materialized deployment definition.
provenance.binding_policy: The source already has only empty server_url and project_connection_id placeholders. They are retained byte-for-byte; the publisher supplies deployment bindings. No Project, test Agent name, URL, or credential was copied from the materialized evidence.

authored_structure.change_from_default: Only definition.instructions changes; the Agent remains flat.

candidate_status.assessment_scope: Four captured baseline/candidate voice conversations in a bounded stress/happy probe; not the complete original business cohort.
remaining_failures: Repeated model action announcements and configured interim messages remain.

candidate_status.external_blocker: The evaluated MCP backend did not persist incomplete/invalid OTP state transitions. This snapshot does not modify or fix that backend.
unassessed: Complete business acceptance after the external OTP persistence fix.
